General Information
New in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed)
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
Genuine Suzuki OEM Part
What is This Part?
This is a Suzuki OEM Complete Front Hub.
It Will Fit on Either Side of the Front Axle.
Includes: Wheel Studs & Lug Nuts
BONUS – Comes With an 5 Extra Lug Nuts
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Hub, Front Axle
Qty 5 – Wheel Studs
Qty 10 – Lug Nuts
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
